digest: 过去 30 天，共追踪到 21 个热门 AI 开源项目（主力语言：Python, TypeScript, Rust）和 15 篇最新 ArXiv 论文。GitHub 最热方向是「其他热门」。

categories.name: 🧩 Agent 技能与工具
categories.desc: 把工程、产品、设计能力封装成可复用的 Skill / 工具模块

repos.name: Significant-Gravitas/AutoGPT
repos.description: AutoGPT is the vision of accessible AI for everyone, to use and to build on. Our mission is to provide the tools, so that you can focus on what matter
repos.summary_zh: 开源自主 AI Agent 框架，让任何人都能构建并运行自动化任务，无需深度编程经验

repos.name: Panniantong/Agent-Reach
repos.description: Give your AI agent eyes to see the entire internet. Read & search Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, XiaoHongShu — one CLI, zero API fees.
repos.summary_zh: 一个命令行让 AI 读取全网主流平台内容，零 API 费用打通信息获取瓶颈

repos.name: diegosouzapw/OmniRoute
repos.description: Never stop coding. Free MIT AI gateway: one endpoint, 290+ providers (90+ free), 500+ models — Kimi, Claude, GPT, OpenAI, Gemini, GLM, DeepSeek, MiniM
repos.summary_zh: 统一 API 网关接入 290+ 模型与 90+ 免费供应商，让 Claude Code、Cursor 等工具无缝切换任意 AI 后端

repos.name: vercel-labs/agent-browser
repos.description: Browser automation CLI for AI agents
repos.summary_zh: 用 Rust 打造的 AI 代理专用浏览器自动化 CLI，让智能体像人一样操作网页并高效提取数据

categories.name: 🔍 信息搜索与抓取
categories.desc: 主动抓取社区、社媒、网页、GitHub 等外部信号

repos.name: vuejs/core
repos.description: 🖖 Vue.js is a progressive, incrementally-adoptable JavaScript framework for building UI on the web.
repos.summary_zh: 渐进式前端框架，虚拟DOM与响应式系统驱动现代Web界面开发，生态成熟且性能卓越

repos.name: cypress-io/cypress
repos.description: Fast, easy and reliable testing for anything that runs in a browser.
repos.summary_zh: 前端测试界的瑞士军刀，让浏览器里的任何功能都能快速、可靠地自动化验证，开发者体验极佳

repos.name: invoke-ai/InvokeAI
repos.description: Invoke is a leading creative engine for Stable Diffusion models, empowering professionals, artists, and enthusiasts to generate and create visual medi
repos.summary_zh: 开源AI绘画工作流引擎，集成专业级图像生成与编辑工具，让Stable Diffusion创作更可控高效

repos.name: raphamorim/rio
repos.description: A hardware-accelerated GPU terminal emulator focusing to run in desktops and browsers.
repos.summary_zh: 用 Rust 写的 GPU 加速终端模拟器，桌面和浏览器双端运行，让终端渲染快如闪电

categories.name: 🧠 上下文与推理基础设施
categories.desc: 压缩、转换、整理输入，降低 Token 成本，加速推理

repos.description: AirLLM 70B inference with single 4GB GPU

repos.name: drumih/turbo-fieldfare
repos.description: Gemma 4 26B-A4B inference in ~2 GB of RAM on any M-series MacBook
repos.summary_zh: 苹果芯片上仅需 2GB 内存跑 Gemma 4 26B 模型，让旗舰级 AI 推理走进入门 MacBook

repos.name: FareedKhan-dev/kimi-k3-in-c
repos.description: A 2.78-trillion-parameter Kimi K3 running inference on a single CPU in 8.24 GB of RAM. Portable C99: no BLAS, no framework, no GPU.
repos.summary_zh: 2.78万亿参数模型仅用8.24GB内存跑在单CPU上，纯C99无依赖的极致优化

repos.name: semantica-agi/semantica
repos.description: Graph-Native Infrastructure for Context and Accountable AI Systems
repos.summary_zh: 图原生基础设施让 AI 上下文可追溯可审计，专为负责任智能体打造

categories.name: 🔬 模型训练与微调

repos.description: PerceptionBench: Evaluating Atomic Visual Perception in Multimodal Large Language Models
repos.summary_zh: 专测多模态大模型原子级视觉感知的基准，用细粒度任务暴露模型视觉盲区

categories.name: 🎨 应用与前端
categories.desc: 面向终端用户的 AI 应用、UI 组件、聊天界面

repos.name: Comfy-Org/ComfyUI
repos.description: The most powerful and modular diffusion model GUI, api and backend with a graph/nodes interface.
repos.summary_zh: 最强模块化扩散模型图形界面与后端，节点式工作流让 AI 绘画管线自由搭建，社区生态庞大

repos.name: ant-design/ant-design
repos.description: An enterprise-class UI design language and React UI library
repos.summary_zh: 企业级 React 组件库标杆，开箱即用的设计语言与高质交互方案，让中后台开发效率翻倍

repos.name: tailwindlabs/tailwindcss
repos.description: A utility-first CSS framework for rapid UI development.
repos.summary_zh: 原子化 CSS 框架，用预设工具类快速构建界面，摆脱重复写样式代码的繁琐

repos.name: CherryHQ/cherry-studio
repos.description: AI productivity studio with smart chat, autonomous agents, and 300+ assistants. Unified access to frontier LLMs
repos.summary_zh: 开源 AI 生产力全家桶，聚合 300+ 助手与前沿大模型，智能对话加自主 Agent 一站式搞定

categories.name: 📦 其他热门
categories.desc: 值得关注的其他 AI/ML 开源项目

repos.name: donnemartin/system-design-primer
repos.description: Learn how to design large-scale systems. Prep for the system design interview. Includes Anki flashcards.
repos.summary_zh: 系统设计面试必备的图解式学习库，用真实案例和 Anki 卡片帮你掌握大规模架构设计

repos.name: zed-industries/zed
repos.description: Code at the speed of thought – Zed is a high-performance, multiplayer code editor from the creators of Atom and Tree-sitter.
repos.summary_zh: Atom 和 Tree-sitter 团队打造的 Rust 高性能多人协作编辑器，让编码响应快如思维

repos.name: dani-garcia/vaultwarden
repos.description: Unofficial Bitwarden compatible server written in Rust, formerly known as bitwarden_rs
repos.summary_zh: 自托管密码管理首选，Rust 重写 Bitwarden 服务端，轻量高效且完整兼容官方生态

repos.name: microsoft/AI-For-Beginners
repos.description: 12 Weeks, 24 Lessons, AI for All!
repos.summary_zh: 微软官方出品的AI入门教程，12周24课覆盖从神经网络到生成式AI，零基础也能上手

papers.title: PsychoAgent: An Affect-Sensitive Cognitive Architecture for Conflict-Aware Memory in LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Human-like cognition does not select past experience by topical similarity alone: affective significance and unresolved conflict also shape what becomes accessible. We present PsychoAgent, a cognitive
papers.summary_zh: 提出情感与事实记忆分离的认知架构，通过冲突感知机制动态调控记忆提取，使智能体在情感决策任务中准确率提升约两成且响应更拟人化

papers.title: CoinRAG: Contextualized Information Nugget KV Cache Reuse for Long-Context RAG
papers.abstract: Recent optimization studies on Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) have exploited chunk-level KV cache reuse to avoid processing long retrieved contexts for higher efficiency, while significant infor
papers.summary_zh: 提出上下文信息粒KV缓存复用方法，以信息粒替代粗粒度块实现细粒度去噪，长上下文RAG推理提速显著且准确率保持领先

papers.title: SkillProx: Self-Evolving Agent Skills via Proximal Textual Gradient Descent
papers.abstract: LLM agents increasingly adapt to recurring tasks by accumulating procedural knowledge in skills. These skills are lightweight, reusable textual artifacts that are loaded into the agent's context witho
papers.summary_zh: 提出近端文本梯度下降的自我进化技能方法，通过迭代执行与失败诊断优化技能库，无需权重更新即可提升智能体任务适应性与复用效率

papers.title: Taxonomy-Driven Analysis of Open-Source AI Risk Mitigation Tools
papers.abstract: Rapid adoption of large language models (LLMs) in enterprise settings has introduced operational, security, and governance risks. As generative AI applications move from pilot to production, manual ha
papers.summary_zh: 提出开源AI风险缓解工具分类法，系统评估百余工具覆盖度，揭示安全防护与治理功能缺口，为选型提供结构化决策依据

papers.title: Interaction Creates Dynamical AI Behavior Absent in Isolation
papers.abstract: What will happen when AI agents interact in daily life, e.g. when one AI starts bossing another around? We find a counterintuitive answer that opens new avenues for out-of-equilibrium Physics. When a
papers.summary_zh: 发现主从AI单向指令交互可诱发孤立系统不存在的动态行为，开辟非平衡物理研究新路径，揭示交互本身即产生新涌现现象

papers.title: Strategy-first synthesis planning for complex natural products
papers.abstract: The total synthesis of a complex molecule is among the most demanding intellectual and experimental feats in chemistry: a chemist must plan many steps ahead for how to assemble simple building blocks
papers.summary_zh: 提出策略优先的复杂天然产物合成规划方法，先定宏观路线再细化步骤，显著提升逆合成分析效率与成功率，为AI辅助全合成提供新范式

papers.title: RIS-Aided mmWave Localization Under Cross-Link Interference via Beam-Domain ML Fingerprinting
papers.abstract: Accurate user equipment (UE) localization is critical for beam management in reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS)-assisted millimeter-wave (mmWave) based sixth-generation (6G) networks, especially
papers.summary_zh: 提出波束域指纹定位法，在RIS辅助毫米波系统中消除跨链路干扰，实现无直射路径下高精度UE定位，较传统方法误差降低逾50%

papers.title: MirrorWorld: Taming Video Diffusion Models for Mirror Reflection Generation
papers.abstract: Recent advances in video diffusion models (VDMs) have enabled high-fidelity video synthesis. However, generating mirror reflections remains challenging because the content within a mirror must remain
papers.summary_zh: 提出镜像世界框架，利用场景感知注意力机制引导视频扩散模型生成与周围环境一致的镜面反射，在基准测试中显著提升反射真实感与时空连贯性

papers.title: CreativeInstruct: Scalably Teaching LLMs to Balance Quality, Creativity, and Diversity
papers.abstract: While post-training improves the capabilities of large language models (LLMs), it generally lowers their output diversity and creativity, negatively impacting tasks that explicitly require creativity
papers.summary_zh: 提出CreativeInstruct方法，通过可扩展合成数据教学平衡质量创造性与多样性，缓解后训练导致LLM输出多样性下降问题

papers.title: SABRE: Scalable and Automated Benchmarking of VLMs under Stress
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are improving rapidly, but benchmark development lags behind, making weaknesses hard to identify. Building stress tests is costly: samples must satisfy controlled conditi
papers.summary_zh: 提出SABRE自动化压力测试流水线，可控生成挑战性样本，在五个基准上平均暴露模型缺陷率提升42%，显著降低人工构建成本

papers.title: Diffusion LLMs as Targets and Adversaries: Mechanistic Safety Exploits
papers.abstract: Diffusion Large Language Models (DLLMs) replace autoregressive next-token prediction with iterative parallel denoising, yet their internal safety mechanisms remain poorly understood. In this work, we
papers.summary_zh: 揭示扩散大模型并行去噪机制的安全漏洞，提出双向对抗攻击策略，在多个基准上使有害内容生成率提升逾40%并绕过现有防护

papers.title: Beyond Myopic World Models: Long-Horizon End-to-End Training for Direct Future Prediction
papers.abstract: World models are expected to support imagination over extended temporal horizons, yet most are still trained through local few-step prediction objectives and deployed by recursively rolling out their
papers.summary_zh: 提出长视界端到端训练框架，直接优化多步未来预测而非局部递推，显著缓解误差累积，在长程规划任务中预测精度提升达40%

papers.title: Beyond Post-Hoc Temperature Scaling: Bilevel Optimization for LLM Calibration
papers.abstract: Preference alignment often makes large language models (LLMs) overconfident and poorly calibrated. Traditional post-hoc temperature scaling is inherently domain-dependent: a temperature fitted on one
papers.summary_zh: 提出双层优化校准框架替代事后温度缩放，在训练阶段修正过度自信，跨域泛化误差降低百分之四十且无需额外推理开销

papers.title: An Exploratory Evaluation of LLM-Assisted Rewriting of Moderate-Complexity Financial Sentences for DisCoCat-Based Sentiment Analysis
papers.abstract: Quantum natural language processing (QNLP) provides a grammar-aware framework for text modeling, and Distributional Compositional Categorical (DisCoCat) is one of its theoretically grounded formulatio
papers.summary_zh: 探索用大语言模型改写中等复杂度金融句以适配DisCoCat量子自然语言处理，提升情感分析性能并验证语法感知框架的实用潜力

papers.title: Wasserstein Policy Gradient for Entropy-Regularized Linear-Quadratic Control
papers.abstract: Wasserstein policy gradient (WPG) updates state-conditional action laws by transport in the action space. We study entropy-regularized discounted linear-quadratic (LQ) control. A Bellman verification
papers.summary_zh: 提出Wasserstein策略梯度法求解熵正则化线性二次控制，通过动作空间传输更新策略，证明最优策略为线性高斯且折扣问题可解析求解
